name: magnetic-cursor-follower
title: Magnetic Cursor Follower
description: A trailing fluid pointer node that elongates along its velocity vector when mouse moves fast.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Pill
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Monospace
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Vector Velocity Follower: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
